events.title: Can AST SpaceMobile Regain its Mojo Amid BlueBird 7 Launch Failure?
events.body: ASTS pushes ahead with its space-based network despite losing BlueBird 7, as rapid launch plans and contracts keep its global vision intact.

events.title: Why AST SpaceMobile Could Buy Iridium, Viasat Spectrum To Counter Amazon's Globalstar Deal
events.body: AST SpaceMobile could fire back at Amazon's proposed acquisition of Globalstar by targeting Viasat or Iridium spectrum assets, analysts say.
